summary: DSG Global Inc. filed an 8-K announcing that a court-appointed receiver filed a plan of reorganization in Nevada's 1st Judicial District (Case No. 25 OC 00061 1B) on April 20, 2026, as authorized by the court. Objections to the plan are due by October 10, 2026. The filing is a current report under Item 8.01 (Other Events) and includes the plan of reorganization as Exhibit 2.1. The registrant is in receivership, and the receiver, Robert Stevens, signed the filing. This is a court-supervised restructuring process, typical of a Chapter 11-like proceeding in the US. Watch for objection deadline and court approval timeline; risk-arb angle is limited as this is a distressed restructuring.
